before: A large document opened with its fonts resolved is laid out once, on the shaped measurer, from a cold layout session.
after: A large document opened with its fonts resolved is laid out on the fallback measurer and then on the shaped one, on the same layout session, painting only the second; a small document mounts at its current zoom and fits after.
reason: Only local layout changes. The passes run over the same revision, and nothing about layout enters shared state, operations, snapshots or protocol messages.
